company.name: Pandey Urja LLP
company.motto: Complete Solar Solutions for Your Property
company.description: Pandey Urja LLP is a full-service solar solutions and EPC company based in Surat, Gujarat. We plan, supply, install, and support solar energy systems for residential homes, housing societies, commercial properties, and industrial facilities.
company.corePhilosophy: You come to us with your electricity requirement, and our single team manages the project from start to finish. No middlemen, no jargon, and long-term support.

fourStepApproach.title: Understand the Requirement
fourStepApproach.description: We analyze your 12-month electricity bills, terrace space, and load profile before recommending any system.

fourStepApproach.title: Design the Right Solution
fourStepApproach.description: Site-specific solar design engineered around your roof structure to maximize power output across all seasons.

fourStepApproach.title: Execute Properly
fourStepApproach.description: Certified Tier-1 equipment, mechanical structure anchoring, chemical copper earthing, and thorough pre-commissioning testing.

fourStepApproach.title: Support the System Afterwards
fourStepApproach.description: DISCOM net metering approvals, PM Surya Ghar subsidy assistance, regular panel washing, and lifetime AMC service.

location.fullAddress: Office No. 123, Vaibhav Laxmi Complex, near Sangam Chowkdi, Bhestan, Surat, Gujarat 395023

services.title: Solar Consultation
services.description: We check your electricity bills, sanctioned load, and property space to recommend the right capacity before you invest.
scope: Analysis of previous 12 months electricity consumption
Rooftop space and structural feasibility check
Shading analysis and orientation assessment
Realistic cost, yield, and payback period calculation

services.title: Solar System Design
services.description: Complete system layout designed around your roof structure and appliances for maximum energy generation.
scope: Custom CAD layout simulation for RCC terraces, metal sheds, or elevated structures
Inverter string sizing and DC/AC ratio optimization
Single Line Diagram (SLD) preparation
Wind load and structural safety design

services.title: Complete Equipment Supply
services.description: Direct supply of Tier-1 solar panels, certified inverters, galvanized mounting structures, and electrical BOS under one roof.
scope: Tier-1 Mono-PERC & TopCon high-efficiency solar modules
Certified on-grid, hybrid, and micro-inverters with mobile monitoring
Hot-dip galvanized (GI) and anodized aluminum mounting structures
ACDB/DCDB boxes, copper cabling, earthing electrodes, and lightning arrestors

services.title: Turnkey Installation & Grid Sync
services.description: Safe mechanical structure mounting, precision electrical wiring, earthing pits, and net metering grid synchronization.
scope: Waterproof mechanical roof anchoring without leaks
Chemical copper earthing pits and surge protection installation
UV-resistant conduits and neat cable-tray routing
Testing, commissioning, and DISCOM bidirectional meter connection

services.title: Solar Cleaning & Maintenance
services.description: Regular panel washing, electrical health diagnostics, fault troubleshooting, and ongoing service support.
scope: Scheduled de-mineralized panel cleaning to restore lost generation
Quarterly electrical health inspection and hot-spot checks
Inverter troubleshooting and rapid warranty replacement
Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) for new and existing systems

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What areas in Gujarat do you serve?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: We primarily serve Surat (Bhestan, Vesu, Adajan, Katargam, Varachha, Hazira, Pandesara, Sachin) as well as Navsari, Bardoli, Ankleshwar, Bharuch, and South Gujarat.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Do you help with net metering in Surat?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, we coordinate all net metering applications with DGVCL (Dakshin Gujarat Vij Company Ltd) and Torrent Power, including meter testing and bi-directional meter synchronization.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Can I get maintenance if my solar plant was installed by someone else?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes. We offer panel cleaning, inverter diagnostics, repair services, and AMC contracts for systems installed by any vendor.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What are your office hours?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Our corporate office in Bhestan, Surat is open Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
